note: The workflow changes approved for the historical-data handoff. Read by guard_update_yml.py (Python guards) and tests/approved_workflows.js (JavaScript guards). update.yml must differ from the commit by EXACTLY these added lines (an empty difference is fine once they are committed); the two historical workflows must be byte-for-byte the pinned versions. Any other edit to these files, or any edit to another workflow, still trips the protected-file guards. Changing them again means updating this file on purpose. It also records the one approved change to each of fundamentals_updater.py and financials_updater.py (the five-stock test batch, research_test_batch.py): each file must differ from the commit by EXACTLY the listed diff lines (an empty difference is fine once they are committed). Stage 4 (SENSEX publication guard): update.yml and market_data.yml each differ from the commit by EXACTLY the four lines of the SENSEX guard (the closed approval variable on the Build site folder step and the sensex_publish.py call after the last copy); the earlier historical-handoff lines of update.yml are already committed. Stage 6B: .github/workflows/sensex_data.yml (the manual, non-publishing SENSEX pipeline) is a NEW file pinned byte for byte by SHA-256, like the two historical workflows; any edit to it needs this record updated on purpose. Stage 9D (market activity in the daily build): update.yml differs from the commit by EXACTLY the added lines listed under update_yml: one continue-on-error step that runs market_data_updater.py then validate_market_outputs.py and, if either fails, removes the four derived market_*.json files and exits non-zero; and, before the SENSEX guard, rm -f of _site/out/index_history.json, market_breadth.json, market_movers.json and market_dma.json (only market_activity.json stays eligible). Once committed, the difference is empty again. Stage NIFTY-refresh: historical.yml gained a weekday 19:00 IST schedule (13:30 UTC) and its hand-over, upload and save steps now also run for scheduled runs (never for a push), so the NIFTY 50 benchmark in historical/historical.json is refreshed after every trading session; its pin was updated on purpose.
